title: Robust Block Preconditioning for 3D nonlinear steady-state radiation transport equations
summary: In this work, based on the discrete ordinate method, we propose a robust block preconditioning strategy for the 3D nonlinear steady-state radiation transport equation with heat diffusion term. The presence of the diffusive term of the temperature equation prevents its elimination into a single equation for the radiation intensity. To overcome this difficulty, all physical variables are assembled into a single monolithic linear system.
